emergency_helplines.title: National Emergency Number (All-in-One)
emergency_helplines.description: Unified pan-India emergency number for immediate life-safety emergencies, accidents, and urgent medical assistance.
emergency_helplines.authority: Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA), Government of India

emergency_helplines.title: National Medical Ambulance Service
emergency_helplines.description: Immediate emergency ambulance dispatch for acute medical trauma, heart emergencies, stroke, respiratory distress, and pregnancy care.
emergency_helplines.authority: Emergency Management and Research Institute (EMRI) / State Health Departments

emergency_helplines.title: Medical Advice & Health Information Helpline
emergency_helplines.description: Round-the-clock medical triage advice, health schemes consultation, blood bank availability, and health grievance redressal.
emergency_helplines.authority: National Health Mission (NHM) / State Health & Family Welfare

emergency_helplines.title: Tele-MANAS (National Tele Mental Health Programme)
emergency_helplines.description: Free, confidential psychological first-aid, crisis support, psychiatric guidance, and mental wellness counseling across India.
emergency_helplines.authority: NIMHANS & Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW)

emergency_helplines.title: National Women in Distress & Domestic Safety Helpline
emergency_helplines.description: Emergency response, safe shelter, legal counsel, and immediate rescue for women facing violence or distress.
emergency_helplines.authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development (MWCD)

emergency_helplines.title: Elder Line (Senior Citizen National Helpline)
emergency_helplines.description: Emotional support, medical information, elder abuse rescue, and pension guidance for senior citizens.
emergency_helplines.authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

emergency_helplines.title: Childline (National Emergency Service for Children)
emergency_helplines.description: Free emergency phone outreach service for children in need of care, protection, and medical attention.

emergency_helplines.title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Beneficiary Helpline
emergency_helplines.description: Inquire about PM-JAY golden card status, empanelled public and private hospitals, and Rs 5 lakh annual hospital coverage.

emergency_helplines.title: eSanjeevani National Teleconsultation Helpline
emergency_helplines.description: Guidance on connecting with government doctors and specialists for free video medical consultations.
emergency_helplines.authority: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC) & MoHFW

emergency_helplines.title: National Poisons Information Centre (AIIMS)
emergency_helplines.description: Urgent toxicological advice for accidental poisoning, pesticide exposure, snake bites, and chemical ingestion.
emergency_helplines.authority: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi

emergency_helplines.title: e-RaktKosh National Blood Bank Network
emergency_helplines.description: Check live blood component availability (RBC, platelets, plasma) in nearby government and licensed blood banks.
emergency_helplines.authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW)
